items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I played for her so many times. Bessie was something else. I mean Ethel.

ctx.x: listened to, or had any -- had some influence on the way you play?

Very well. I would like to say Pittsburgh. From Pittsburgh, I joined the show, and we went from Pittsburgh to Chicago, playing the -- was it the Corcoran Theater, or Monogram? Well, I kind of get them confused, because you know, both were small theaters at that time, in each town. Well anyway, after Chicago we went to Detroit, I'm almost positive. Well there I met and saw a very fine trumpeter, trumpet lady, maybe I should say. She was playing trumpet for Ethel Waters. She was a backup for Ethel, because Ethel…
